title: The Christian and the Church
description: A lesson on the meaning of the church, the believer’s relationship to it, and its purpose in Christian life.

cards.heading: The Meaning of the Church
cards.scriptureText: I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.
cards.body: The church is the gathering of believers. It includes the local church, where believers meet in a specific place, and the universal body of Christ, which includes all who are truly saved.
cards.question: How do you understand the difference between the local church and the body of Christ?

cards.heading: Christ Established the Church
cards.scriptureText: And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
cards.body: The church was established by the Lord Jesus Christ and continues to grow as God adds those who are saved.
cards.question: Why is it important to recognize that the church belongs to Christ?

cards.heading: A Christian’s Relationship to the Church
cards.body: A true Christian should be committed to a local church that faithfully preaches God’s Word, regularly attends worship services, and participates in fellowship and Sunday school.
cards.question: How involved are you in your local church today?

cards.heading: The Purpose of the Church
cards.scriptureText: To equip his people for works of service...
cards.body: The church exists for worship, prayer, teaching, ordinances such as baptism and communion, evangelism, and strengthening believers.
cards.question: Which purpose of the church has helped you most in your spiritual growth?

cards.heading: Church Discipline
cards.scriptureText: If your brother or sister sins, go and point out their fault...
cards.body: Biblical discipline helps protect the holiness of the church, restore believers, and maintain faithfulness to God’s truth.
cards.question: How do you view discipline as an act of love and correction?

cards.heading: Application: Be Faithful in the Church
cards.scriptureText: Encouraging one another and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
cards.body: The church is the center of worship, service, and spiritual growth. A true believer should faithfully participate in church life.
cards.question: What can you do this week to be more active in your church?
